Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2 + `target:v18`:** release text that an upgrading agent greps says stored reactions are gone, while the shipped CLI converts them (`os migrate comment-reactions`). An agent that trusts it may skip the conversion before GA.
- **Why `domain:services`:** the main text is `@objectstack/plugin-audit`'s own `CHANGELOG.md`. `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` and `.changeset/pre/22573-sys-comment-reactions-retired.md` are declared on the claim. One docs-only PR, as the card says.
- **Governed edit:** amending a consumed `.changeset/pre/` note is AGENTS.md's DELIBERATE CORRECTION. It needs the maintainer's written confirmation on the PR (precedents PR #23418 and PR #23784). #23860's allow rule only removes the auto-mode prompt; it does not replace the confirmation.

Claim: PM loop round 10 · 2026-10-16T14:52Z
Session: `session_018VqJPGA1NDNSCZsnecsChP` (the dispatching seat; the dev runs `mode:subagent` in this session's container and shares its session ID, so its identity is the branch)

Branch: `claude/issue-23938-reactions-changelog-amend`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-23938`
Domain: `domain:services`
Seat: `domain:services#2` (seat post #21118)
File surface (at `origin/main` `6d1660dc3b` or later; stop on a breach and explain it in the report). Release text only, in a docs-only PR:
- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/CHANGELOG.md`: the 22573 entry (~:198–:222) and the earlier "unchanged in this release" bullet (~:197), where it states stored reactions are not converted;
- `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md`: the same sentences (~:3290–:3345);
- `.changeset/pre/22573-sys-comment-reactions-retired.md`: the consumed source, so the GA re-render carries the correction.
The weaker second reading (22360 / 15204-7b positions) only if the dev measures it false today; otherwise it is noted, not edited.
Exclusions: ⛔ no code, no test, no new changeset, and no other CHANGELOG entry. ⛔ Not the 23281 changeset's supersession sentence: it stays as history.
Container & model: `S, release text, with a measured premise per sentence (what os migrate comment-reactions and apply --allow-destructive actually do on main) ⇒ S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`TIER_DEFAULT`; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on this surface: "no path-derived mandate")
Clause-②: no — release text moves no export, type or accept set.
Responsibility: `plugin-audit release text (this lane): the published 22573 entry says stored reactions survive the upgrade, names os migrate comment-reactions as the conversion and then the verified drop | none: the entry is this package's | the 23281 changeset's supersession sentence stays as history`
Thread-read: `6217209696`
Ruling-ref: none. Triage's first grade `6217209696` is the routing. AGENTS.md's Prime Directive table (the `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` row: amend the entry in a dedicated docs-only PR, never an erratum) is the rule.
Serial constraints cleared: none of the 13 open PRs touches either CHANGELOG or `.changeset/pre/22573-*` (their file lists were read at this write).
Landing note: amending a consumed `.changeset/pre/` note is a DELIBERATE CORRECTION. A diff that changes only release text is confirmed by the dispatching seat's ACCEPT, which quotes each changed sentence before and after (the skill's landing operations). A design fork, if one appears, goes to the decision box.

Timeline: `added_to_merge_queue` 2026-10-16T16:30Z → `merged` 2026-10-16T17:02Z. ACCEPT `6219955925` confirmed the DELIBERATE CORRECTION sentence by sentence. The PR carried `Check Changeset`'s designed red into the queue, as that ACCEPT recorded.

| Probe on `origin/main` | Reading |
|:--|:--|
| "…stored in `sys_comment.reactions` survive the upgrade" | 1 each in plugin-audit `CHANGELOG.md`, spec `CHANGELOG.md` and `.changeset/pre/22573-*` |
| "…are gone after the upgrade" (the false sentence) | 0 in all four files |
| "…reactions stored in it are not converted" (the 22566 bullet) | 0 in all four files; its replacement "`os migrate comment-reactions` converts the reactions stored in it into records" is present |

**What a reader now finds:** an upgrading agent that greps `sys_comment.reactions` lands on an entry that says the stored reactions survive, that `os migrate comment-reactions` converts them, and that the column drop waits for a verified conversion. That matches what the shipped CLI does.

**Not filed (seat answer A on the PR):** the plugin-security 18.0.0-next.0 entries that name a catalog row object next.1 retires, such as 22360. They stay as history. A pre-GA sweep of superseded prerelease entries would be a release-process rule, and that is the maintainer's call.
